SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE - Light-sheet imaging of cleared mouse brain slices (fictional study)

This is a fictional study used to demonstrate the bia-submission-kit. It does not describe real data. Two mice contribute two cleared brain slices each, imaged with one light-sheet setup and processed with one segmentation pipeline.
Fictional work funded by the Example Funding Agency (grant EX-0001).

SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE. Brains were fixed by immersion in 4% paraformaldehyde for 24 h, cut into 300 µm coronal slices on a vibratome, cleared with a hydrogel-based clearing protocol and stained with a nuclear dye. Slices were mounted in refractive-index-matched medium.
